title: The Rising Cistern
story: Thrashwell the Cistern Gnawer has chewed a hole in the town cistern, and water is pouring into the cellar where three kittens perch on a crate 9 feet above the floor. The water rises 2.5 feet every minute, while Mr 6's bailing crew drains 1 foot every minute. Mr 6 must know exactly how long the crate stays dry.
question: How many minutes until the water reaches the top of the crate, 9 feet up?
solution: Each minute the water really rises by 2.5 - 1 = 1.5 feet.
The crate stays dry for 6 minutes.
praise: Dividing by a rate was exactly the right instinct — the missing step was subtracting the bailing from the rising first.
hint: The bailing crew fights the leak, so first find the NET rise each minute.
victory: With one minute to spare, Mr 6 plugged the hole with his helmet and ferried the kittens out on a floating crate, calling it 'the fluffiest cargo of the year'.
imagePrompt: A numeral-six knight wading in a flooding stone cellar with three kittens on a floating crate while a long-toothed eel-like gnawer peeks from a chewed pipe, lantern light rippling on rising water.
